title: Freelancer/Gig Worker Rate Impact by 2028
description: Projected change in average freelancer hourly rates for AI-exposed categories (writing, design, translation, data work) by 2028.

overlays.label: Imperial College: high-skill freelancers hit hardest; top performers saw largest setbacks
PNAS: ChatGPT halved working times in ~1/3 of tasks
ILO review: substitution already occurring in writing & translation
Ramp: freelance spend fell 0.66% → 0.14% of total
CAIS/Scale AI: Best AI agent captures only $1,720 of $143,991 freelance value (1.2%)
Upwork FY2025: GSV per client +7% YoY; AI skills +109%; revenue +2% to $787.8M

sources.title: Upwork Freelance Forward 2023
sources.excerpt: Writing freelancers reported 15% fewer job postings; early signs of rate compression in translation and content categories.

sources.title: Fiverr Business Trends Report H2 2023
sources.excerpt: Average order value for writing gigs declined 20%. AI-assisted gig categories (AI art, prompt writing) grew 4x but at lower price points.

sources.title: The Impact of Generative AI on Freelance Labor Markets
sources.excerpt: ChatGPT's launch caused a 21% decline in freelance writing job postings and a 15% drop in average hourly rates within 6 months.

sources.title: Upwork Q2 2024 Earnings Report
sources.excerpt: Gross services volume in writing declined 33% YoY. Translation down 40%. Company pivoting to AI-augmented freelancer model.

sources.title: How is AI affecting freelance jobs?
sources.excerpt: Generative AI is upending freelance work. High-skill freelancers were disproportionately impacted, with top performers seeing the largest setbacks in both contracts and earnings.

sources.title: World Employment and Social Outlook 2025: Platform Labour
sources.excerpt: Platform workers in writing, translation, and data labeling report median earnings declines of 15-25% since 2023.

sources.title: Ramp Economics Lab: Freelance Marketplace Spending Collapse
sources.excerpt: Business spend on freelance marketplaces fell from 0.66% to 0.14% of total spend. Writer earnings on these platforms dropped ~31% (based on marketplace spending data; other studies find 5-33% declines depending on metric). Over half of businesses stopped using freelancers for AI-automatable tasks.

sources.title: Winners and losers of generative AI: Early Evidence of Shifts in Freelancer Demand
sources.publisher: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization (Teutloff, Einsiedler, Kässi, Braesemann, Mishkin, del Rio-Chanona)
sources.excerpt: Demand for substitutable skills (writing, translation) decreased 20-50% relative to counterfactual after ChatGPT launch. Short-term (1-3 week) jobs saw sharpest decline. ML programming demand grew 24%; AI chatbot development nearly tripled. Novice worker demand declined across complementary skill clusters.

sources.title: The Unequal Adoption of ChatGPT Exacerbates Existing Inequalities Among Workers
sources.excerpt: Workers see ChatGPT halving working times in about a third of tasks, but employer restrictions and required training hinder adoption.

sources.title: Is Generative AI a Job Killer? Evidence from the Freelance Market
sources.excerpt: High-skill freelancers disproportionately affected by AI — top performers were impacted most, contradicting conventional wisdom that expertise insulates workers.

sources.title: AI and jobs: A review of theory, estimates, and evidence
sources.excerpt: Digital trace data show substitution already occurring in writing and translation tasks; declining demand for novice workers across AI-complementary freelance work.

sources.title: Fiverr Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
sources.publisher: Fiverr International Ltd. (SEC Filing / Press Release)
sources.excerpt: Full-year 2025 revenue of $430.9M, up 10.1% YoY. Active buyers down 13.6% in 2025. Spend per buyer reached $342, rising 13% YoY. Writing, translation, and simple programming categories declining ~20% due to AI substitution. High-value projects over $1,000 grew 23%. 2026 revenue guidance: $380M-$420M, a decline of 3-12% YoY.

sources.title: Upwork Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
sources.excerpt: Revenue grew 2% year over year to $787.8 million for full year 2025. GSV per active client was $5,129 in Q4 2025, an increase of 7% year over year. AI-related skills grew by 109% year over year. Active clients were 785,000 as of December 31, 2025.

sources.title: Remote Labor Index: Measuring AI Automation of Remote Work
sources.publisher: Center for AI Safety / Scale AI (Mazeika et al.)
sources.excerpt: Best AI agent (Manus) earned $1,720 out of a possible $143,991 across 240 real freelance projects — capturing only 1.2% of economic value. Automation rate: 2.5%.
